key_insight: PMC-PaIR uses citation-linked case reports and question-guided language models to build clinically similar image pairs that improve medical image retrieval.
clinical_relevance: Retrieving images with similar clinical findings could support diagnosis, teaching and research, but clinical benefit was not evaluated.
method: Follow citations between open-access PubMed Central case reports to identify potentially similar cases.
Use language models to ask and answer hierarchical questions about modality, diagnosis and findings, then match images using captions.
Fine-tune BiomedCLIP on the resulting image pairs and evaluate retrieval.
evidence_signal: The dataset contains 86,144 image pairs from 56,013 case reports; experts judged pairs highly accurate, question-guided matching found twice as many correct pairs as direct matching, and fine-tuning improved retrieval across all tested categories.
watch_item: Case reports often feature rare or challenging presentations, so generalization to routine clinical imaging needs further evaluation.
paper_title: A dataset of clinically similar image pairs from citation-linked case reports for medical image retrieval
